exposure: Maternal nutritional status (pre-pregnancy BMI, BMI at parturition)
Maternal zinc and iron intakes during pregnancy
outcome: Zinc stores at birth (cord blood zinc)
Iron stores at birth (cord blood ferritin)
cohort: The study enrolled 117 pregnant women at the end of the second trimester and followed them until delivery.
finding: Cord blood zinc was associated with pre-pregnancy BMI and maternal serum zinc, while cord blood ferritin was associated with pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: Cord blood zinc and ferritin were significantly higher in infants born via vaginal delivery compared to those born via cesarean delivery.
